links.outcome: Ambient scribe documentation quality, usability, corrections needed, time, and uneven adoption across clinicians
links.effect: Documentation quality improved (overall median 23 vs 17; p=0.008), but 67% reported technical issues, 33% needed extensive corrections, and adoption was under one-third of trained clinicians.
links.quote: Fifty-five percent of users reported being satisfied or very satisfied, although 67% reported technical issues and 33% reported requiring extensive corrections.

unlisted_practices: Direct observation of eye contact and clinician-patient interaction with ambient scribe use

screen.reason: Prospective observational evaluation of an ambient AI medical scribe deployed in real pediatric outpatient clinics, assessing its effect on clinical interaction, note quality, and adoption barriers.
